correctness.rationale: For all 120 five-point permutations the integer Costas displacement criterion is exhaustive and selects exactly 40. A fifth-root character vanishes exactly when its five residue counts are equal, by the cyclotomic polynomial. Affine-Galois symmetry reduces the 3125 frequencies to one constant orbit and 156 size-20 orbits, with the complete 157-row certificate and two separately constructed integer checker implementations proving exactly 16 vanishing nonconstant classes. Full-frequency overlap and rank arithmetic are checked directly. No floating-point or asymptotic argument enters.

value.rationale: A complete codebook of Costas permutations is a natural discrete signal-design ensemble. Translation-convolution rank measures which additive multi-coordinate Fourier modes are recoverable from the codebook. The exact 16-character-class obstruction, four Costas-specific cancellations, and rank contrast 2805 versus 625 against all unrestricted permutations are nonobvious structural data, not supplied by the known count 40. This gives a compact reproducible benchmark for ensemble harmonic measurements; it does not claim direct radar-performance gains.
